what: Clicking a link to another page of the same site covers the screen with 3px cell dots. Two noise layers (.65·.35, flowing at time ×.15) at 2.2x·5x screen height are read per cell, and cells where progress×1.6 − noise×.6 exceeds an 8×8 Bayer threshold turn on, so the dots fill in as if spreading along a cloud pattern. Cover .8s power3.in, and on the arrival page it uncovers with the same pattern over 1s power2.out · look: soft — no dots, noise at screen ×4 value spreads with a .38 edge while a pale gray curtain covers over 1.5s (power1.out), the text ”Loading” turns on after .3s, and on the new screen it melts away over 1.8s

options.cover: Cover length (seconds), default .8 (look: soft is 1.5). At 0 it skips the cover and navigates right away (app screens with frequent navigation)
options.look: soft: No dither dots. A single layer of value noise passes a soft threshold and spreads as a translucent cover from there. Default curtain color is the background mixed with 3.5% of the text color, a pale gray
options.scale: look: soft noise size (cells per screen side), default 4
options.edge: look: soft threshold width, default .38 — larger means a blurrier edge
options.cover-ease · ease: Cover and clear curves, default power3.in · power2.out (look: soft makes both power1.out)
options.[data-fx-part=text]: Center text of the curtain (“Loading” + leaf) — when covering, it turns on over 1s after .3s, and when lifting, it turns off over 1s. Position and font are set in the consuming css (fixed center)
options.nav: When off, links are not intercepted — fire fx:cover or fx:uncover events on an element (detail.done is called when finished) and only the curtain moves (with detail.instant on fx:cover it covers immediately). Use this when plugging into Taxi or barba transitions.
options.--fx-cover: Cover color (css variable — set on .fx-noise-cover in the consuming css), default var(--kf-ink)

use:
— Covers and uncovers when moving between pages with the same part. With Taxi, use data-fx-noise-dither-cover="nav: off" Leave it as is, fire fx:cover in the transition’s onLeave, and fx:uncover once the new screen stands · for a light noise cover, use data-fx-noise-dither-cover="look: soft" At

from.where: shared.js Taxi transition — original blue-gray 3px cell noise dither cover, cover .8s power3.in · reveal 1s power2.out

shared.js page transition (original #webgl: full-screen plane, noise ×4 · threshold width .38, progress 1.3→−1 1.5s cover · −1→1.3 1.8s reveal, curtain color .97 gray, .transition-text-cover 1s · .3s delay). The site copy is built on three r155 like the original, and the part uses the same shader on raw WebGL

note: Without WebGL, the curtain covers and clears with opacity over the same length. Before clearing, the original waits up to 1s for the new page’s 3D model to be ready — that wait is left to the caller (the moment it fires fx:uncover).
